answer: An answer declaring deep analysis must run at least 290 characters, and one declaring a brief note must stay under half that, so length has to match the claim. A farm cannot pad to satisfy both, because the declared depth is published in the saffron receipt and checked against the wander nonce, so a padded text pays the fee and is refused anyway. Since the ripple audit keeps the pair, the mismatch is rejected rather than silently down-graded. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
